rv.q: Surinderella is an intercultural celebration that proves old stories can still feel new, while also reflecting the vibrant culture of modern Britain.
Surinderella offers enjoyable moments, some good performances and plenty of sparkle.

cn.t: Rifco Theatre Company's South Asian-inspired Cinderella delights with Bollywood magic, heart, and humor, delivering a wildly enjoyable pantomime elevated by strong performances and glittering production values.
